description: This file contains implementation of Logistic Regression models and training algorithms within Apache Spark's MLlib, including classes for the model, training with SGD and LBFGS, and related utilities.

classes.name: LogisticRegressionModel
classes.description: Represents a trained logistic regression model supporting binary and multinomial classification, with methods for prediction, threshold setting, and model persistence.

classes.name: LogisticRegressionWithSGD
classes.description: Trainer for logistic regression using stochastic gradient descent, supporting binary classification.

classes.name: LogisticRegressionWithLBFGS
classes.description: Trainer for logistic regression using LBFGS optimization, supporting multinomial and binary classification.

methods.name: predictPoint
methods.description: Computes the prediction score or class for a given data point based on model weights and intercept.

methods.name: setThreshold
methods.description: Sets the classification threshold for binary logistic regression.

methods.name: clearThreshold
methods.description: Clears the threshold to output raw scores instead of class labels.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the model to the specified path.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a model from the specified path.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Trains a logistic regression model on input data, with options for initial weights and using MLlib or mllib implementations.
